vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: authensor-gateway
Version: 0.7.0

The Authensor Gateway skill is designed to enhance security by acting as a policy gate for OpenClaw tool calls. Its `SKILL.md` provides explicit instructions to the AI agent to classify actions, redact sensitive data (like API keys and credentials) before sending metadata to an external control plane (authensor-control-plane.onrender.com), and enforce a 'fail-closed' policy if the control plane is unreachable. The skill's instructions are entirely defensive, aiming to prevent data exfiltration and malicious execution, and it explicitly states it is 'instruction-only' with no executable code. There is no evidence of malicious intent or harmful behavior.
